scenario_description:
Objective: Avoid losing a newly assigned bilingual oral-screening standby seat before it can count toward the pending attendance requirement.
Emerging Need: Early roster chatter does not justify action because no seat or code exists; a later assignment creates a short risk window before export lock.
Decision Context: Stored acknowledgement rules and requirement status distinguish this from optional practice, while live directory, calendar, and desk notices determine the valid channel, availability, and identifiers.
Consequence: Timely acknowledgement can keep the future screening path open; once export lock starts, the unheld seat is set to release even though the assessment has not occurred.
